name: household and enrollment test report
query:
SELECT 
    -- hf.name, hf.landmark, hf.date_of_visit, hf.hamlet, hf.respondent_name, 
    -- hf.hosuehold_head_name, hf.respondent_age, hf.is_the_family_a_pvtg, 
    -- hf.primary_occupation, hf.pvtg_name, hf.primary_occupation_other, 
    -- hf.number_of_family_members, hf.children_6_to_18_years, hf.adults_above_18_years, 
    -- hf.is_anyone_of_your_family_a_migrant_worker, hf.family_members_enganged_as_migrant_workers, 
    -- hf.no_of_months_the_migrants_were_away_last_year, hf.does_anyone_from_your_family_migrate_every_year, 
    -- hf.do_you_take_your_children_along_with_you, hf.who_looks_after_them_at_home, hf.remarks, 
    -- hf.parent, hf.parenttype, hf.parentfield, hf.social_category_id, hf.hhguid, 
    -- hf.verfication_status, hf.primary_occupation_id, hf.partner_id, hf.state_id, 
    -- hf.district_id, hf.block_id, hf.gp_id, hf.village_id, hf.respondent_gender_id, 
    -- hf.app_created_by, hf.children__3_years, hf.children_3_to_6_years, hf.verification_status, 
    -- hf.workflow_state, hf.hhid, hf.religion, hf.any_other_religion, hf.creche_id, 
    -- hf.any_other_gender, hf.no_of_pregnant_women, hf.whether_the_household_migrated_from_settlementvillage, 
    -- hf.phone_no, hf.hh_id_janadhikara, hf.which_is_your_native_state, hf.which_is_your_native_district,
    -- -- Child form fields
    -- hcf.name AS child_form_name, hcf.parent AS child_parent, hcf.child_name, hcf.child_age, 
    -- hcf.is_dob_available, hcf.child_dob, hcf.relationship_with_child, hcf.hhguid AS child_hhguid, 
    -- hcf.hhcguid, hcf.gender_id AS child_gender_id, hcf.relation_with_child_other, 
    -- hcf.any_other_gender AS child_any_other_gender, hcf.mother_tongue,
    
    -- rg.gender AS respondent_gender,
    -- r.religion AS religion_name,
    -- sc.social_category_name,
    -- po.primary_occupation AS primary_occupation_name,
    -- nm.no_of_months,
    -- yn.option_name AS migration_status,
    -- cg.gender AS child_gender,
    -- cr.creche_name AS "Creche",
    -- g.gp_name AS "GP",
    -- b.block_name AS "Block",
    -- d.district_name AS "District",
    -- s.state_name AS "State",
    -- p.partner_name AS "Partner"

    cee.*
    
FROM `tabHousehold Form` AS hf
LEFT JOIN `tabHousehold Child Form` AS hcf ON hf.name = hcf.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabCreche` AS cr ON cr.name = hf.creche_id
LEFT JOIN `tabGender` AS rg ON rg.name = hf.respondent_gender_id
LEFT JOIN `tabReligion` AS r ON r.name = hf.religion
LEFT JOIN `tabSocial Category` AS sc ON sc.name = hf.social_category_id
LEFT JOIN `tabPrimary Occupation` AS po ON po.name = hf.primary_occupation_id
LEFT JOIN `tabNo of Months` AS nm ON nm.name = hf.no_of_months_the_migrants_were_away_last_year
LEFT JOIN `tabYesNo` AS yn ON yn.name = hf.whether_the_household_migrated_from_settlementvillage
LEFT JOIN `tabGender` AS cg ON cg.name = hcf.gender_id
LEFT JOIN `tabChild Enrollment and Exit` AS cee ON cee.childenrollguid = hcf.hhcguid
INNER JOIN `tabPartner` p ON p.name = cr.partner_id
INNER JOIN `tabState` s ON s.name = cr.state_id
INNER JOIN `tabDistrict` d ON d.name = cr.district_id
INNER JOIN `tabBlock` b ON b.name = cr.block_id
INNER JOIN `tabGram Panchayat` g ON g.name = cr.gp_id
LIMIT 500
;
